integrity: The covariance increment is derived directly from the one-step attachment indicators and independently replayed by exact rational state enumeration through size 9. The asymptotic constant follows from the standard gamma-ratio expansion for the probability that the initial vertex remains a leaf.
scientific_limitations: The exact finite constants are for the one-edge seed and linear degree-proportional attachment.
The theorem is a covariance statement, not positive association or a joint limit theorem.
Older preferential-attachment literature may contain an equivalent mixed recurrence implicitly.
title: Oldest-hub degree has positive square-root covariance with leaf abundance
